tools.name: kimodo_help
tools.description: Return the command manual, detailed parameter documentation for one command, or currently viable model configurations.

command.description: Command name whose full manual entry should be returned.

tools.name: kimodo_debug_install_server
tools.description: [debug-only] Incrementally install the QuickServer runtime from the package template, preserving models and the Python environment, then restart it.

tools.name: session_open
tools.description: Create a new current animation editing Session, or load an existing named Session.

session_name.description: Existing Session name to load; omitted always creates a new Session.

tools.name: session_close
tools.description: Close the current animation editing Session while preserving it for a later named reopen.

tools.name: query_current_session
tools.description: Query characters, a character's animations, one animation, character constraints, or animation constraints.

character.description: Safe character name in the current Session.

animation.description: Safe animation name in the selected character.

tools.name: session_try_add
tools.description: TryAdd a humanoid character, AnimationClip, or AnimatorController content to the current Session. Deterministic Clip-to-Clip transitions are baked; BlendTree choices remain explicit Timeline work.

character.description: Scene character name/path for kind=character, or target Session character name otherwise.

tools.name: session_try_remove
tools.description: TryRemove a character track or one clip. Removing a clip does not move other clips or reuse its virtual time address.

character.description: Safe character name in the current Session.

tools.name: kimodo_analyze
tools.description: Analyze one named animation or a Session frame range and cache the result under a stable analysis_id.

character.description: Safe character name in the current Session.

animation.description: Safe animation name; mutually exclusive with start_frame/end_frame.

start_frame.description: Inclusive Session frame at 60 FPS; requires end_frame.

end_frame.description: Exclusive Session frame at 60 FPS; requires start_frame.

analysis_option.description: Optional QuickServer analysis configuration; analysis_only is forced true.

tools.name: kimodo_bake_range
tools.description: Bake a Session time range into an AnimationClip and append it to a character; optionally retarget it to another current Session character.

character.description: Safe source character name in the current Session.

remove_root_motion.description: Keep vertical motion but remove horizontal root translation and yaw; defaults to false.

output_folder.description: Unity folder under Assets; defaults to Assets/KimodoGeneratedClips.

tools.name: kimodo_generate_animation
tools.description: Append a configured KimodoPlayableClip to the character Timeline and generate its AnimationClip asset. Without a current Session, a retained __KimodoAuto__ Session is created and closed after generation.

character.description: Safe scene or Session character name.

duration_frames.description: Duration in 60 FPS Session frames; defaults to 300.

model.description: Registered model name/configuration id; omitted uses the Project Settings default. Use kimodo_help({section:'models'}) to query models.

seed.description: Deterministic seed; omitted chooses a random seed.

diffusion_steps.description: Diffusion steps; omitted uses the model default.

output_folder.description: Unity folder under Assets; defaults to Assets/KimodoGeneratedClips.

name.description: Requested safe animation name; defaults to the prompt.

analysis_option.description: Optional analysis object; set keyframes.enabled=true to return screenshot keyframes.

constraints.description: Inline constraints {frame,type,pose}; root2d may use position and heading instead of pose.

frame.description: Relative frame in the generated clip at 60 FPS.

tools.name: query_picture
tools.description: Render explicit poses, a cached analysis, or inline constraints together in one four-view square image.

constraints.description: Inline constraints in the same format accepted by kimodo_generate_animation.

frame.description: Relative frame in the generated clip at 60 FPS.

character.description: Character used to frame position-only Root2D constraints.

resolution.description: Square output size in pixels; defaults to 512.

tools.name: pose_create
tools.description: Create a writable pose for a character.

pose.description: Pose data containing root, muscles, and optional foot_ik.

tools.name: pose_get
tools.description: Read a pose from any returned {source,frame} locator.

tools.name: pose_copy
tools.description: Copy any pose into a writable pose for the target character.

tools.name: kimodo_build_root2d_path
tools.description: Build dependency-free Root2D path points at fixed 60 FPS.

max_speed.description: Maximum units per second; defaults to 2.5.

acceleration.description: Acceleration/deceleration units per second squared; defaults to 2.5.

direction.description: left or right; defaults to left.

tools.name: kimodo_get_generation
tools.description: Get generation progress and the generated animation safe name.

request_id.description: Request id returned by a generate tool.

tools.name: kimodo_cancel_generation
tools.description: Cancel an active Kimodo generation request.

request_id.description: Request id returned by a generate tool.
